name: Kolff artificial kidney treatment
description: Willem Kolff’s team treated a patient with an artificial kidney in 1945; she regained consciousness and lived for years afterward.

date.basis: Date refers to the scoped documented case, not global origin.

events.statement: Willem Kolff’s team treated a patient with an artificial kidney in 1945; she regained consciousness and lived for years afterward.

evidence.supports: The review describes Kolff and Hendrik Berk’s artificial kidney in 1943 and the recovery of a patient in 1945. Earlier human dialysis work existed. Case details and dates vary between retrospective sources; survival of one patient is not an estimate of treatment effectiveness.

events.caveats: Earlier human dialysis attempts existed. This single acute-care case is not evidence of long-term chronic dialysis access or a measured treatment effect; retrospective accounts differ on subsequent survival duration.
